evidence_spans: An AMR signal of ∆ρ/ρ ⊥ = (ρ∥ −ρ ⊥)/ρ⊥ = 0.66 % was measured between the resistivity in the parallelρ ∥ and perpendicularρ ⊥ configurations of current and magnetization.
We used a Keithley 2400 sourcemeter to apply a 10 mA current through the outer set of probes and simultaneously detect the voltage between two inner probes.
An AMR signal of ∆ρ/ρ ⊥ = (ρ∥ −ρ ⊥)/ρ⊥ = 0.66 % was measured between the resistivity in the parallelρ ∥ and perpendicularρ ⊥ configurations of current and magnetization.
CLM-DEV-0082.statement: An anisotropic magnetoresistance signal ∆ρ/ρ⊥ of 0.66% was measured on the full-film NiFe/Co/Gd stack with a current of 10 mA applied along the hard axis.

extra_quotes: The devices were fabricated using physical vapor deposition (magnetron sputtering and electron-beam evaporation) and four electron-beam lithography steps with transfer via etching and lift-off.
AMR was measured with a four-probe resistance measurement, i.e., with a current applied along the hard axis and the voltage measured along the same axis (see inset in Fig. 1d).
All measurements to some degree suffered from linear drift, which we corrected for during data processing in Fig. 1d and subsequent figures in this work.
